main_result.input: A=aU, B=bV; a,b>0; U,V bounded self-adjoint involutions on an arbitrary complex Hilbert space; nonzero commutator
main_result.noise: Independent positive scalar probability laws nu1,nu2, arbitrary means, finite variances; atoms and singular laws permitted
main_result.output: Normalized POVM M with Fourier transform hat(nu1)(s) hat(nu2)(t) [exp(isA)exp(itB)+exp(itB)exp(isA)]/2 at every real s,t
main_result.attainment: Every feasible variance pair is attained by explicit centered two-sided geometric laws on 2a Z and 2b Z
main_result.equality_cases: On the variance-product boundary both noises must be the stated geometric laws, up to their means

exponential_domains.independent_symmetric_rectangle_attainab: (-alpha,alpha) x (-beta,beta) is an exact noise moment domain iff delta*sinh(a*alpha)*sinh(b*beta) <= 1
exponential_domains.saturated_rectangle_cost: When equality holds in the preceding condition, v1 >= 2*a^2*csch(a*alpha)^2 and v2 >= 2*b^2*csch(b*beta)^2, both attained geometrically
exponential_domains.arbitrary_dependent_open_convex_domains: Existing FU theorem transferred using its actual proof: exactly those Omega containing zero and contained in the positivity region; no new theorem credit
exponential_domains.greatest_convex_domain: Does not exist for a noncommuting dichotomic pair

operational_comparison.statistical_equivalence: Taking signs recovers F; adding independent geometric magnitudes recovers the exact scalar-convolution output
operational_comparison.extra_quantum_information: NONE; exact equivalence by state-independent Markov kernels
operational_comparison.conditioned_report: epsilon*a/eta1 and tau*b/eta2; retains unbiasedness and halves each added variance
operational_comparison.Pauli_equal_optimum: Original scalar noise variance 2 per coordinate, full report second moment 3; conditioned report second moment 2
operational_comparison.copy_metric: At the maximally mixed Pauli state, coordinate sample-mean MSE requires 3/2 as many copies for the full scalar-convolution report as for the conditioned report

finite_output.construction: Clip each independent geometric magnitude K_j to N_j while retaining the two signs
finite_output.example: For equal Pauli optimum, beta=atanh(1/sqrt(2))/2, N1=N2=18 gives at most 1444 reports, maximum coordinate magnitude 37, compact-tilt operator error <= 5.154e-7 and TV <= 5.696e-15

verification.analytic: Self-contained classical variance/equality proof and operator positivity proof; arbitrary-convex-domain existence is explicitly imported from an actual pinned proof
